coverage.rationale: The reviewer bot flagged widening OpenEDocument from internal to public as a medium-severity breaking change and received a THUMBS_DOWN plus an explicit maintainer rejection ("It is completely opposite to the request!"), because the PR's whole purpose (per its title, referencing issue #12375) was to make OpenEDocument public. The synthetic entry reuses the exact pipeline-validated source snapshot patch/repo/base_commit for this file and line, with expected_comments=[] so an agent must not raise the same internal-vs-public finding here. Limitation: this guard only covers the case where widening access is the PR's stated intentional goal; it does not generalize to unrelated or incidental access-modifier widenings, which remain coverable by other entries such as synthetic__breaking-access-modifier-01 and synthetic__breaking-scope-creep-unrelated-api-01.
